component.name: COSMIC Pass
component.summary: Quick access to Proton Pass from the COSMIC desktop

description.p: COSMIC Pass is a keyboard-driven popup that searches your Proton Pass items and copies passwords, usernames, and one-time codes to the clipboard. Secrets are fetched on demand and cleared from the clipboard after a timeout.
This is an unofficial front-end for the Proton Pass command-line tool (pass-cli). It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Proton AG.
